name: Salt Mirror
mood: An endless flooded salt flat at twilight where a thin film of brine doubles the star-streaked cobalt sky above submerged hexagonal salt ridges. Open a coin and it rises on a crystalline salt pedestal mirrored in the water; tap anywhere to send concentric ripple rings across the horizon.
